wardrobe.description: Consistent playground outfit: sky-blue short-sleeve top, coral-orange shorts, white ankle socks, and red sneakers with white soles. Clothes should be practical for climbing, crouching, and playing in sand.
No clothing; Leo is a small golden lion cub with an expressive fluffy mane used for gentle comedy. Keep him soft, friendly, and childlike rather than fierce.

anchors.description: Tall playground slide with ladder steps, platform, smooth chute, and sand at the bottom.
Small waiting line area in the sand at the foot of the slide ladder.
Rounded green bush near the slide queue, large enough for Leo to peek from behind.
Large shade tree across a short sandy path from the slide, with visible roots and fallen leaves underneath.
One broad brown dry leaf under the large tree, used as the small place for anger.

locations.description: A sunny public playground with soft tan sand, a tall slide, a simple queue area, a leafy bush, and a large shade tree. The whole story stays within this one open garden so the slide, bush, tree, and sand remain spatially consistent.
locations.lighting: Warm natural daylight, soft shadows, cheerful colors; emotional tension may be shown through posture and composition rather than dark weather.
locations.name: Neighborhood playground garden
locations.topology: Single continuous playground. The slide queue is beside the ladder. The bush sits near the queue with a clear peek-out sightline. The large tree is a short walk away across the sand, still visible from the slide area. The dry leaf lies under the tree and remains there through the ending.

recurringProps.description: A bright, sturdy playground slide high enough to require a short ladder climb, central to the queue conflict and final success.
recurringProps.material: painted metal or molded plastic with safe rounded edges
recurringProps.name: Tall playground slide
recurringProps.persistence: Visible or implied from pages 1-2, 4-6, and 10-12; keep color and structure consistent.
recurringProps.scale: taller than the children, suitable for a playground

recurringProps.description: The first step is important when the child almost begins climbing and another child cuts in.
recurringProps.name: Slide ladder steps
recurringProps.persistence: Consistent with the tall slide whenever the ladder base is shown.
recurringProps.scale: child-sized ladder attached to the slide

recurringProps.description: Warm tan sand covering the playground, comfortable underfoot and at the bottom of the slide.
recurringProps.name: Soft playground sand
recurringProps.persistence: Present throughout all pages as the shared outdoor surface.
recurringProps.scale: ground surface across the whole playground

recurringProps.description: A leafy green bush near the slide where Leo first appears.
recurringProps.name: Rounded bush
recurringProps.persistence: Appears clearly on page 3 and may remain as a background anchor near the slide.
recurringProps.scale: about waist-high to a child, large enough to hide a small lion cub

recurringProps.description: A calm tree across the playground that creates the quieter space for the anger exercise.
recurringProps.material: brown bark, green canopy, exposed roots
recurringProps.name: Large shade tree
recurringProps.persistence: Introduced visually by page 7 and remains important through page 12.
recurringProps.scale: large enough to cast shade over child, Leo, and leaf

recurringProps.persistence: Appears pages 7-12; uncreased at first, rustles during page 9, and has a small crease by page 12.
recurringProps.scale: large enough for both child hands to rest on or near, but still a single fallen leaf
